name: fsearch
title: FSearch
description: Find files across your Mac with fuzzy search, powerful filters, and indexed content search.
author: anzor

commands.name: search
commands.title: Search Files
commands.subtitle: FSearch
commands.description: Search your Mac by filename or file contents

preferences.name: binaryPath
preferences.title: FSearch Executable
preferences.description: Path to the fsearch executable. Leave it empty to look in ~/.local/bin, ~/.cargo/bin, and Homebrew's bin folders.

preferences.name: searchRoot
preferences.title: Search Folder
preferences.description: Optional folder to search within. Leave empty to search the whole index.

preferences.name: showDetails
preferences.title: Results
preferences.label: Show the preview pane by default
preferences.description: Open results in a split view with a file preview and metadata. Toggle it any time with ⌘ D.
